text:
alex: FYI seeing a p99 regression on /v1/generate starting ~09:20 UTC. p95 is fine (~420ms) but p99 jumped to ~2.4s and some clients report timeouts.
maria: thanks — any error spikes or just latency? logs/RTT look?
alex: error rate steady (~0.2%), no 500 spike. CPU/GPU utilization steady. tail latency seems correlated with a subset of long sequences.
shiv: can you paste the query pattern? any big seq_len or streaming clients?
alex: most requests are short (<256 tokens) but we do have a batch of a few customers sending 2–3 long chat turns concurrently. Putting sample curl from support:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-7b-q","input":"...long history...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

support-ops: reporting from one customer: timeouts at ~30s, they hit client retry which amplifies tail.
oncall-bot: alert fired: p99 latency > 2s for 5m on /v1/generate in prod-us-west.
maria: quick triage checklist: 1) isolate by region/model 2) check KV cache hit rates 3) see if batching window increased 4) check recent rollout/infra changes.
shiv: KV cache hit for that model dropped from 78% -> 12% around the same time. Possible cache invalidation or model variant mismatch.
sre-tim: if KV cache is cold, p99 will spike for those long sequences. Mitigation options (pick one ordered by risk):
  - enable model fallback: route those requests to rwd-7b-q-lt (quantized small cache friendly) for tiered latency SLO
  - temporarily increase per-customer rate limit to avoid client retries causing thundering herd? (careful)
  - enable circuit breaker for the route to return 503 quickly to high-retry clients
  - warm the KV cache by replaying recent prefixes or prefill common histories
  - shift traffic to eu-west or another pool with healthy cache if routing compatible

alex: can we do fast fallback to rwd-7b-q-lt per-policy? how to trigger?
maria: yes, we have a rollout flag. quick command:

```json
POST /admin/routing/fallback
{"route":"/v1/generate","from_model":"rwd-7b-q","to_model":"rwd-7b-q-lt","policy":"latency-first","scope":"prod-us-west","duration":"30m"}
```

shiv: I'll flip fallback for the affected customer groups and add a circuit-breaker threshold: p99 > 1.5s for 10m -> return 503 with retry-after. Also set client-facing message to avoid immediate retries.
support-ops: also advising customers to reduce max_tokens temporarily.
oncall-bot: action logged: fallback enabled by shiv at 09:38 UTC, circuit-breaker rule added.
alex: after fallback, p99 dropped to ~480ms within 3 min. KV cache hit slowly climbing.
maria: please run the KV-prefill job to warm top prefixes (job: prefill-kv recent-prefixes --model rwd-7b-q)
shiv: kicked prefill, monitoring.
sre-tim: post-mortem playbook items:
  - root cause hypothesis: cache invalidation due to recent model variant rollout + a small set of long-history customers
  - immediate mitigations applied: model fallback, circuit-breaker, prefill
  - longer-term: implement smarter prefix-based cache retention, add auto-fallback thresholds in routing, add per-customer backoff advisory in docs

support-ops: I'll draft a customer comms note and include recommended client retry/backoff config.
alex: thanks everyone. opening follow-up ticket: SRE-4456 to track cache hardening + routing guardrail automation.
maria: mark this thread resolved once SRE-4456 has an initial plan. :thumbsup:
